data.long_meaning: Mother of One Who Scatters (Rain). Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Asmaee usually hope their child will grow to embody mother of a scatterer and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_arabic.name: أسمعي

in_english.name: Asmaee
in_english.meaning: Related to hearing or good listening
in_english.long_meaning: The name Asmaee originates from the Arabic root 's-m-ʿ', meaning 'to hear' or 'listening'. In an Islamic context, it may signify a person with the ability to hear well or one who listens attentively and follows the truth. Historically, names derived from this root reflect high spiritual and moral qualities. The name is used across various Muslim cultures to denote virtues related to auditory perception and spiritual attentiveness.

Historically, water was considered a source of life, and the ability to bring rainfall was a highly revered skill among water deities and attendants. Naming a child "Asmaee" could be a testament to the importance of rain and water in one's culture and lineage.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual realm, the name "Asmaee" holds deeper meaning. It symbolizes the concept of being a provider, a giver, and a sustainer - much like the rain and its ability to nourish and bring life. This name's spiritual significance encourages individuals to strive towards being selfless, giving, and nurturing to their loved ones, community, and the world around them. This name serves as a constant reminder of the role of being a provider and nurturer in one's faith and daily life.
